questions.question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'absent'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the type of figure. The author of the passage already mentions that the man whose story it is is not a fictional character. 
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options (all of which are adjectives) - 
 
 
• callous - showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others.
 
• absent - not present in a place, at an occasion, or as part of something.
 
• ordinary - with no special or distinctive features; normal.
 
• profuse - (especially of something offered or discharged) very plentiful; abundant.
 
 
 
• From the above-listed meanings, we can conclude that absent is the most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 4.**
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 

Correct passage__ - *Novelists when they write novels tend to take an almost god-like attitude (1) __towards__ their subject, pretending to have a total comprehension of the story, a man's life, (2) __which__ they can therefore recount as God Himself might, nothing standing between them and the naked truth, the entire story meaningful in (3) __every__ detail. I am as little able to do this as the novelist is, even though my story is more important to me than any novelist's is to him – for this is my story; it is the story of a man, not of an invented, or possible, or idealised* *or otherwise (4) __absent__ figure, but of a unique (5) __being__ of flesh and blood. *

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**analysed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing a study that compares the antioxidant power of various foods and drinks.
 
• The phrase "out of all the foods and drinks ______" implies that an analysis or comparison was made in the study.
 
• "Synthesised" means produced, which does not fit this context.
 
• "Consumed" means eaten or drunk, which would not fit the structure of the sentence here.
 
• "Assimilated" means absorbed, which is different from the action being described.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1) Numerous health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2) attributed to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3) utilised by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4) analysed__, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5) ______, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Synthesised: Means to produce something by chemical or biological synthesis, not suitable here.
 
• Consumed: Means eaten or drunk, which does not fit the context.
 
• Assimilated: Means absorbed, but the context here is about analytical comparison.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. against is the correct word to use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "against" is correctly used to compare the tea output of two different years.
 
• "Against" is appropriate for indicating how something is compared to another.
 
• It sets up a comparison between the tea output of the next year and that of the last year.
 
• The sentence structure implies a comparison, making "against" the most fitting choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Correct answer

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 3.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'accounts.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***According to eyewitness ___(3)___, elephants screamed and ran...***'' is indicating screaming and running of elephants.
 
• The use of the word ''eyewitness'' in the sentence indicates **a person who has seen something happen and can give a first-hand description of it**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'accounts'.
 
• The word 'accounts' means **somebody’s report or description of something that has happened**. 
 
 
• Example:* His illness **accounts** for his absence*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

The complete sentence:- *Before the giant waves slammed into the coast in India and Sri Lanka, wild and domestic animals (1) seemed to know what was about to happen. (2) They fled to safety. According to eyewitness (3)accounts, elephants screamed and ran for (4)higher grounds, dogs refused to go outdoors, flamingoes abandoned (5)their low-lying breeding areas, and zoo animals rushed into their shelters.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us explore the other options:

__
 
• '**Explanations**' means **a statement, fact, or situation that gives a reason for something**. (किसी बात के कारण की व्‍याख्‍या; स्‍पष्‍टीकरण)
 
• 'S**tatement**' means **something that you say or write, especially formally**. (कथन, प्रकथन, वक्तव्‍य)
 
• '**Narrations**' means **the action or process of narrating a story**. (कथा वर्णन, विवरण)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*According to eyewitness ___(3)___, elephants screamed and ran...*'' हाथियों के चीखने और दौड़ने का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'eyewitness' शब्द का प्रयोग **उस व्यक्ति को इंगित करता है जिसने कुछ घटित होते देखा है और इसका प्रत्यक्ष विवरण दे सकता है**।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'accounts' है।
 
• शब्द 'accounts' का अर्थ है **घटित घटना का विवरण; लेखा-जोखा**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *His illness accounts for his absence*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *According to eyewitness accounts, elephants screamed and ran...*

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. uptrend is the most appropriate option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the trend of tea prices in the domestic market.
 
• The context provided before and after the blank suggests a **positive change** in tea prices.
 
• The term "uptrend" accurately describes a situation where prices or values are moving **upward**.
 
• Other options do not correctly reflect the **positive movement** in prices as indicated by the passage context.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decline** indicates a decrease, which is opposite to the context provided.
 
• **Incline** can suggest an upward movement but is more commonly used to describe physical slopes rather than trends.
 
• **Upgrade** implies improvement or elevation in quality or status, not specifically related to price trends.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. rebounding is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "rebounding" in this context refers to Harry's miraculous survival and counteraction against Voldemort's killing curse.
 
• "Rebounding" suggests a bounce back or recovery from a negative event, which aligns with Harry's experience of surviving a curse meant to kill him.
 
• The narrative of Harry Potter involves magical combat and survival against dark forces, making "rebounding" a fitting description of his encounter with Voldemort.
 
• The use of "rebounding" also hints at the supernatural resilience or protective magic that saved Harry, which is a central theme in the Harry Potter series.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Rallying" often implies gathering or coming together for a cause, which does not fit the context of surviving a curse.
 
• "Recovering" suggests a process of healing or getting back to a normal state after an injury or illness, but it does not adequately capture the instantaneous survival of a lethal attack.
 
• "Failing" is opposite to the intended meaning, as it would suggest that Harry did not survive the attack, which contradicts the storyline.

questions.question:
**Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.**

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax ______ (3) ______ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to ______ (5) ______ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"capture."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Capture'** means to take possession or control of something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या पशु को बंदी बनाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The lion was **captured**__ and taken back to the zoo.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about proposals to change corporate tax schemes to capture money from tech firms.
 
• Grammatically,** 'capture' **fits well with the preposition** 'to' **that follows it.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax ______ (3) ______ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to __**capture**__ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (take**) also means to acquire or get hold of something, but it does not convey the idea of control or possession as strongly as 'capture'. (किसी को लेना या ले जाना; किसी के साथ कहीं जाना)
 
• **Option 2 (remove) **means to take away or eliminate something, which is not relevant in this context. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को हटा या मिटा देना)
 
• **Option 3 (seize) **means to take hold of something forcibly, which may not be an appropriate word choice in a business context. (किसी वस्‍तु को एकाएक और कसकर पकड़ लेना; छीन लेना, झपट लेना)
